requirement: This code should implement a control logic for a heat exchanger system, where it calculates the process value (PV) based on system parameters and control outputs. The function block should accept inputs Kp (system gain), Tp (process time), CO (output from controller), Dead_t (response delay time), C (initial steady state value), and Sample_time (sampling interval) with appropriate data types. The output PV should be updated only if the current time minus the last update time exceeds the Sample_time. The calculation of PV involves exponential decay based on Tp and linear combination of the last process value (lastPV), the control output (CO), and a constant C. The function should handle the timing using system time functions and ensure that updates occur at intervals specified by Sample_time. Constants and intermediate variables like A, B, and delta_t should be defined and used for the calculations.
provide_code:
// AJ Jaworowski 2015-02-22
// Following the recipe by  Peter Nachtwey
// http://www.controlguru.com/wp/p80.html
FUNCTION_BLOCK HeatExchanger
VAR_INPUT
	Kp: REAL; //System gain
	Tp: REAL; //Process time
	CO: REAL; //Output from controller
	Dead_t: REAL; //The time before the system responds to the disturbance
	C: REAL; //Initial steady state value
	Sample_time: TIME;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
	PV: REAL; //Process value at t1
END_VAR
requirement_cn: 这段代码应实现一个热交换器系统的控制逻辑，根据系统参数和控制输出计算过程值（PV）。功能块应接受输入Kp（系统增益）、Tp（处理时间）、CO（控制器输出）、Dead_t（响应延迟时间）、C（初始稳态值）和Sample_time（采样间隔）并使用适当的数据类型。只有当当前时间减去上次更新时间超过Sample_time时，才更新输出PV。PV的计算涉及基于Tp的指数衰减和上一个过程值（lastPV）、控制输出（CO）以及常数C的线性组合。函数应使用系统时间函数处理时间，并确保更新发生在由Sample_time指定的间隔内。应定义并使用常数和中间变量如A、B和delta_t进行计算。
